Values._comment_mcs: Current MCS path: POST /api/cua-run writes a Dataverse trigger row; GET /api/cua-run/{runId}/progress reads Computer Use progress and the result receipt.
Values._comment_foundry: Current Foundry path: /api/foundry-claims/* validates the signed-in user's relay token, then forwards to the hosted agent with the Function app managed identity.
Values._comment_capacity: Optional: 1 refuses NEW Foundry starts unless the pool reports a free Cloud PC (Graph beta cloudPcPools/{id}; managed identity needs CloudPC.Read.All). 0 = previous behaviour.
Values._comment_legacy: Retired paths only. Leave blank for a new install.
